statements.statement: Level service FY27 school budget stands at approximately $28.2 million.
Additions discussed at the tri-board (restoration items) would add about $979,000-$980,000 on top of level services, including highest-tier family health plans for every added position.
Health insurance is budgeted at about $4.4 million in the FY27 level service budget, reflecting a 14.4% increase, though the town has not finalized that figure.
This year's (FY26) school budget is $26.2 million, including an extra $500,000 the district received from the town.
The FY27 level-services budget is a little less than a $2 million increase over FY26, including the health insurance increase.
The Chapter 70 aid figure for FY27 went up only a little under $200,000, not much.
With the restoration positions added, the FY27 budget would be about $2.8-2.9 million over the FY26 budget.
The school committee has not yet been given a final number from the town to build the FY27 budget to, unlike in prior years when a town manager's budget was issued in January.
Committee members discussed whether to ask the tri-board for the full amount (level services plus restoration) as the override ask, rather than a partial figure.
A member reaffirmed support for asking for the full 2.9 million restoration/increase figure rather than a smaller amount, viewing the restoration as necessary rather than optional.
The committee leaned toward requesting a single override number rather than a tiered override, reasoning that multiple numbers confuse voters and could suggest lower amounts are acceptable.
